description: Defines the media::AudioProcessor class responsible for applying audio processing effects such as echo cancellation and noise suppression to input audio streams, utilizing WebRTC's AudioProcessing module. It includes methods for processing captured audio, analyzing playout data, managing audio processing configurations, and handling audio format parameters.

classes.name: media::AudioProcessor
classes.description: A class that manages audio processing effects on input audio streams, leveraging WebRTC's AudioProcessing module, and providing interfaces for processing, configuration, and statistics.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AudioProcessor with specified callbacks, settings, and formats.

methods.name: ProcessCapturedAudio
methods.description: Processes incoming captured audio, applies effects, and delivers processed audio via callback.

methods.name: OnPlayoutData
methods.description: Analyzes playout audio for purposes like echo cancellation.

methods.name: SetOutputWillBeMuted
methods.description: Instructs the processor to reduce complexity when audio is muted.

methods.name: OnStartDump
methods.description: Starts a diagnostic dump of audio processing.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics from the WebRTC audio processing module.

methods.name: GetAudioProcessingModuleConfigForTesting
methods.description: Returns current APM configuration for testing purposes.

methods.name: input_format
methods.description: Returns the input audio format parameters.

methods.name: output_format
methods.description: Returns the output audio format parameters.

methods.name: ComputeInputFormat
methods.description: Computes a compatible input format based on device format and settings.

methods.name: GetDefaultOutputFormat
methods.description: Provides an output format optimized for minimal delay and resampling.
